newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - fuel oil gains, others dip.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - fuel oil gains, others dip.

text.p: NWE oil products opened mixed on Tuesday, gas oil slipping slightly, while healthier demand lifted fuel oil, dealers said.
High sulphur fuel oil traded as high as $84.50 fob Rotterdam, at least $1 a tonne higher than on Monday.
Some traders said the strength was the result of persisting shorts in the bunker market. Overall bunker demand was described as "reasonable".
Heating oil barges were 50 cents down as IPE gas oil futures dipped. Premiums, however, were unchanged. Rotterdam product was assessed at around IPE +$1 fob.
